item.title: South Korean Police Lose Seized Crypto by Posting Password Online
item.description:
📝 South Korea’s National Tax Service seized crypto assets during recent enforcement actions against 124 high-value tax evaders, but now, a large chunk of that crypto cash has been lost. As these cases illustrate, full self-custody in crypto places significant responsibility on individuals. This independence comes with new vulnerabilities, and criminals have increasingly turned to home invasions and violence against people known to hold substantial crypto.
🔗 Read more: https://gizmodo.com/south-korean-police-lose-seized-crypto-by-posting-password-online-2000728191
